miniaudio — header-only audio decoding library (WAV, OGG-Vorbis, MP3, FLAC).
Upstream: https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio
File vendored: miniaudio.h (single-header, public domain / MIT-0, see header).

NOVAForge usage: decode-only. The implementation is compiled once in
Engine/Audio/src/MiniAudioImpl.cpp with MA_NO_ENCODING; output stays on the
engine's AudioDevice seam (Null/WASAPI), miniaudio never touches hardware.

To refresh: download miniaudio.h at a newer commit, update this file,
rebuild NFAudio + AudioTests. No other integration changes should be needed.
Pinned: master as of 2026-09-16 (miniaudio.h, 4108168 bytes).
